svg.title: Build proof before naming an heir
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-kinship-decision-tree; chart type: decision_tree; title: Build proof before naming an heir; subtitle: A research triage tree, not a distribution formula; chapter number: 7; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values identify nodes. Edges are stated in detail; local law decides succession, representation and shares.; caption: Relationship evidence supports legal analysis; it does not replace a court's finding of entitlement.; stages: label: Governing instrument?; value: Node 1; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Valid will or trust: follow counsel's instrument analysis; otherwise continue to node 2.; label: Spouse or descendants?; value: Node 2; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Yes: document and refer for allocation; no: continue to node 3. Spousal rights may coexist with descendants.; label: Parents or collateral kin?; value: Node 3; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Yes: prove each link and refer for statutory priority; no or uncertain: continue to node 4.; label: Evidence unresolved?; value: Node 4; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Stop distribution assumptions; obtain missing records and counsel's direction on further classes or escheat.
